name: services/exams/search_exams_registrations
description: Get all active exam registrations for selected faculty and date range not longer than month

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.description: Registration that ends after selected date will be returned

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.description: Registration that starts before selected date will be returned.Note that maximal allowed period is one month

arguments.name: faculty_id
arguments.description: ID of faculty that exam registrations should be returned

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of exam method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

errors:
• object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist;

  • params_invalid - parameters start_date and end_date have invalid values.

    Possible reasons:

    • session_not_found - end_date must follow start_date;

    • too_long_date_range - date range must be not longer than one month.
